quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #23
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 14

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow arrow traffic signal?

options.text: Move into the lane in the direction of the arrow.
You can turn left if you yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
You have the right-of-way and oncoming traffic must stop for you.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn left if you yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow arrow means you can turn left in that direction. However, oncoming traffic has a green light, so you must let them pass and watch for pedestrians.

questions.question: You must let a pedestrian cross when they are:
questions.correctAnswerText: Crossing any street.
questions.explanation: You must always let pedestrians cross. This includes marked crosswalks, unmarked crosswalks, and any street. Safety is the most important concern.

questions.question: When driving at night on a dimly lit street, what should you do?

options.text: Drive slowly enough to stop within the light from your headlights.
Use high beam headlights to see vehicles ahead better.
Keep your dashboard lights bright so other drivers can see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive slowly enough to stop within the light from your headlights.
questions.explanation: At night, you cannot see as far ahead. You should drive slowly enough that you can stop safely within the area lit by your headlights.

questions.question: When can you cross a single solid white line on the highway?

options.text: Only if traffic or road conditions make it necessary.
Only to turn into a driveway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only if traffic or road conditions make it necessary.
questions.explanation: You can cross a single solid white line to pass or change lanes only when something in the road or traffic makes the move necessary.

questions.question: Which of these helps direct drivers into the correct lanes on highways?

options.text: White lines on the side of the road
White arrows in the middle of the lanes

questions.correctAnswerText: White arrows in the middle of the lanes
questions.explanation: White arrows in the lanes show which lanes to use for driving straight or turning.

questions.question: You are in the left lane with two lanes going your direction. Many vehicles are passing you on the right. What should you do?

options.text: Stay in your lane to keep traffic flowing.
Drive onto the left shoulder to let vehicles pass.
Move to the right lane when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to the right lane when it is safe.
questions.explanation: Use the left lane to pass or turn left. Use the right lane when you are going slower than traffic around you, entering the road, or turning right.

questions.question: When parking downhill on a two-way street, which way should you turn your wheels?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the right.
Turn your wheels to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheels to the right.
questions.explanation: Turn your wheels toward the curb when parking downhill. If your car rolls, it will roll away from traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is to the right.

questions.question: If your car is about to be hit from behind, what should you NOT do?

options.text: Press your head against the head restraint.

questions.correctAnswerText: Unbuckle your seat belt.
questions.explanation: If hit from behind, your body will be thrown backward. Keep your seat belt on. Brace yourself by pressing against your seat and putting your head against the head restraint to prevent injury. Hold the steering wheel firmly and be ready to brake.

questions.question: Which road is most likely to be slippery after snow or rain in cold weather?

options.text: A road in a shaded area

questions.correctAnswerText: A road in a shaded area
questions.explanation: Shaded areas freeze before other roads on cold, wet days. They also thaw later. Watch for ice in shaded spots.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Truck route is to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not turn left.
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When passing vehicles going the same direction, you should pass on their:

options.text: Left side only if the other driver signals it is safe.
Left side whenever you get a chance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left side.
questions.explanation: The left lane is for passing. Pass only when it is safe and legal.

questions.question: When exiting the interstate, when should you slow down?

options.text: About halfway through the exit lane.
As you get close to the exit lane.
Right when you enter the exit lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right when you enter the exit lane.
questions.explanation: Keep your speed until you enter the exit lane. Then slow down to match the speed posted for the exit ramp.

questions.question: You are waiting in the intersection to turn left. What should you do?

options.text: Signal and turn your wheels to the left.
Signal and keep your wheels straight.
Flash your headlights to get other drivers to let you through.
Drive around the back of a car blocking you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal and keep your wheels straight.
questions.explanation: Always signal before turning. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn. This way, if a car hits you from behind, you will not be pushed into oncoming traffic.

questions.question: A solid white line on the right edge of the road angles toward the center. This means:

options.text: You are near a construction area.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road gets narrower ahead.
questions.explanation: A solid line on the side of the road marks the road's edge. When the edge line angles toward the center, the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: This symbol is used for:
questions.correctAnswerText: Slow-moving vehicles.
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on a vehicle means it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It looks like an orange triangle during the day and a red triangle at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: A steep hill is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: A broken yellow centerline means:

options.text: You can pass on the right if the road ahead is clear.
You can pass on the left if the road ahead is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass on the left if the road ahead is clear.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow centerline allows you to cross it to pass another vehicle on the left as long as there is no oncoming traffic. Never cross a solid yellow centerline to pass.

questions.question: How long does it take the body to process a 12-ounce beer?
questions.correctAnswerText: About one hour.
questions.explanation: On average, the body removes the alcohol from 12 ounces of beer, 5 ounces of wine, or 1.5 ounces of hard liquor in about one hour. For a 150-pound male, one drink raises blood alcohol by about 0.02 percent. Women may process alcohol more slowly, resulting in higher levels that last longer.

questions.question: When turning left onto a one-way street, which lane should you enter?

options.text: The lane closest to where you came from.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to where you came from.
questions.explanation: Always turn from the lane closest to the direction you came from. Turn into the lane nearest to your previous lane.
